title: Extract orphaned rollout artifacts and harmonize config timeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Over the last three years we accumulated multiple rollout artifacts and compatibility adapters in the route/config registry: stale rollout nodes, versioned config blobs, and small compatibility shims used by older operator flows. These artifacts complicate runtime routing, prolong config reads, and cause sporadic operator confusion when editing rollouts. Goal: identify and safely remove orphaned rollout artifacts, consolidate timeline metadata into a single canonical history field, and replace runtime lookups that rely on old version encodings with a normalized resolver. This reduces config read paths, simplifies later rollouts, and lowers cognitive load for SRE/Platform engineers.
scope: Identify orphaned rollout records (no active routes, older than 18 months, not referenced by current manifests)
Create DB migration to mark then delete orphaned artifacts in two-phase run (mark -> delete after 7 days)
Migrate per-route version fingerprints into canonical timeline field and remove versioned 'compat' keys
Replace runtime adapter code that reads legacy query-param versioning with resolver that reads canonical timeline
Add feature-flag toggle to gate deletion and runtime switch for safe rollbacks
Add dashboards and alerts to monitor config delta counts, deletion progress, and any increase in 404s or route-misresolve rates
out_of_scope: Customer-facing UI changes to rollout editor (future design ticket)
Bulk migration of non-route artifacts (separate inventory project)
Changing rollout semantics or policy decisions (we only normalize storage/references)
acceptance_criteria: All identified orphaned rollout artifacts are deleted in the DB and confirmed by inventory query
Runtime no longer reads legacy 'v0' query-param or compat keys for normal traffic (flag-gated rollout)
No increase in routing errors or 5xxs attributable to config reads for 48h post-rollback window
Deletion job runs are auditable with logs and an admin endpoint to list removed artifact IDs
Confluence runbook updated with rollback steps and verification queries
plan: Week 1: Audit and inventory — produce list of candidate orphan keys, sample checks against active manifests (Maya/Luca)
Week 2: Implement mark-and-sweep DB migration (mark TTL 7d) and feature flag to enable deletion (ENG)
Week 3: Implement canonical timeline field migration and runtime resolver changes behind flag; add integration tests
Week 4: Canary runtime switch in staging + run deletion on staging; monitoring and smoke tests
Week 5: Progressive rollout to production (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 24–48h stabilization windows
Post-rollout: Run final audit, close ticket, and create follow-up for UI cleanup if needed
changes: Runtime change: route_resolver.use_canonical_timeline = true behind flag
Admin API: /admin/rollouts/orphans -> list & preview; /admin/rollouts/delete -> operator-triggered endpoint
Telemetry: add metric config.orphan_count and histogram for config_read_latency
Tests: unit + integration covering legacy compatibility path and new resolver fallback
risk_mitigation: Two-phase delete (mark then delete after 7 days) to allow operators to inspect candidates
Feature flag gating for all runtime changes with immediate rollback path
Canary rollout by account/region and metric-based abort conditions
Automated smoke tests on each rollout step including route resolution validation queries
Retention of backup export (S3) of deleted artifact payloads for 30 days
